sql: SELECT e.payload FROM (SELECT p.* FROM field_index x CROSS JOIN (SELECT e.id,CASE e.type WHEN 'Note' THEN 0 END major,e.seq ord FROM entities e WHERE e.type IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)) AND e.trashed=0) p WHERE x.entity_id=p.id AND x.type IN ('Note') AND x.field=? AND x.value=?) p JOIN entities e ON e.id=p.id ORDER BY p.major,p.ord LIMIT 1

plan.detail: SEARCH x USING INDEX field_lookup (type=? AND field=? AND value=?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY
